limitations: Candidates: named uppercase functions with JSX or Solid Component annotations; wrapper factories and anonymous defaults require manual review.
Test evidence records dependency paths from imports/reexports and browser path literals; execution and behavioral coverage require component parity tests.
Dynamic classes and translation keys remain expressions; external/utility classes can be unresolved.
CSS selector matches are lexical references; cascade, inherited variables, variants and computed styles require rendered verification.

Exports, import aliases and reexports use the TypeScript checker. Install lockfile dependencies before generating. External references and unresolved internal paths are recorded independently of installed module availability.
moduleLexicalEvidence includes helpers and sibling components; per-component evidence remains lexical, with nested callback bodies.
All conversion and parity statuses require independent verification.
Full sheets are generated artifacts under target/rune-inventory; the tracked index records their hashes. --check recomputes the index without requiring generated sheets.
